name: Habitat
description: Habitat with workspace code, memory and named reusable procedural skills (skills.save/list/get). Executable tool registration remains future S016b.
notes: S015 and S016a (ADR-0022). Saved skills are agent-owned workspace data, not executable capability registrations. Every capability call runs in a fresh rootless container (S006c): no network, read-only root and world, workspace the only writable mount. python.run executes agent code only there. models.ask is excluded because the container tier provides no loopback or GPU path (S006f, deferred). The container image has the Python standard library only.
